description: This file defines a struct and methods for handling JSON-based communication over Unix socket connections, enabling sending and receiving JSON objects with thread safety considerations.

classes.name: JSONUnix
classes.description: A struct that wraps a Unix socket connection for JSON message exchange, supporting thread-safe send and receive operations.

methods.name: NewJSONUnix
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new JSONUnix instance from a UnixConn.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Serializes a value to JSON and sends it over the Unix socket, thread-safe.

methods.name: Recv
methods.description: Receives a JSON message from the Unix socket and unmarshals it into the provided interface.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the Unix socket connection, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: getNextMsgLen
methods.description: Peek into the socket to determine the length of the next message to be read.
